name: Unshakable
about: A sermon note. Run-sheet lines (Intro, a Video line with no link, Closing prayer) and the line in parentheses are not suggested; the picture is a full-screen Scale and Blur picture slide, the Video line with a link a video placeholder holding the link, and the video file a video slide; the reference line joins its verses; the labelled lines become points under their label.

runs.text: (Welcome back, ask everyone to stand for the reading)

27 This phrase, “Yet once more,” signifies the removing of those things that are shaken, as of things that have been made, that those things which are not shaken may remain. 28 Therefore, receiving a Kingdom that can’t be shaken, let us have grace, through which we serve God acceptably, with reverence and awe.
Intro: the morning of the 1989 earthquake. We were living in Santa Cruz, and the first thing I remember is the sound…
Big idea: What can’t be shaken is what lasts.

blocks.alt: Pacific Garden Mall after the quake

runs.text: Psalm 46:1 – God is our refuge and strength, a very present help in trouble.
“Faith is taking the first step even when you don’t see the whole staircase.” — Martin Luther King Jr.
Next step: Write down one thing you’re holding onto that can be shaken.
Hebrews 12:29 – for our God is a consuming fire.
Closing prayer, worship team back up.
